ὄπτ: ὀπτός — roasted; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὄπτ’ = ὀπτά), predicate adjective agreeing with νῶτα
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as much as’
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥηξήνορος: ῥηξήνωρ — breaking the ranks of men (standing epithet of Achilles); masc. gen. sg.

__broaden__.βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, tmesis ἀνά … βάντες = ἀναβάντες ’having embarked’  ·  also plain, + ἐς and acc. of place entered: ’having stepped into (the tubs)’
__broaden__.κοίλην: κοῖλος — hollow; fem. acc. sg., standing epithet of ships  ·  also of a place (κοίλην Λακεδαίμονα ’hollow Lacedaemon’, i.e. ringed by hills)
__broaden__.κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ‘wide-ruling’)  ·  also honorific of a chief steward, not a king: κρείων Ἐτεωνεύς ’the lord Eteoneus’
__broaden__.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’
__broaden__.ἀτρεΐδην: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, here of Agamemnon); masc. acc. sg.  ·  also used of Menelaus: Ἀτρεΐδην Μενέλαον ’Menelaus, son of Atreus’
__broaden__.νῶι: ἐγώ (dual νῶι) — we two; acc. dual: ’the two of us’ (μετὰ νῶι ’after the two of us’)  ·  also used as nom. dual: νῶι … ἱκόμεθ’ ’we two have come’
